author: Jun Yamasaki
text: We have our house on the market, and of course that's when we got notice we needed to get a whole new septic system... NW Design and the Davis team were very professional from day one, and a little less than 3 weeks after I first contacted them, I just received approval from King County today! Thank you Jennifer, Ramsey and team!

author: Connie Berkbigler
text: Apryl was the first to respond quickly to my inquiry when I was looking for a designer for my septic system. She answered my questions with thought for my particular situation. She came out to my place promptly, designed my new tank and walked me through the application process with the county. Thank you so much Apryl! I would recommend her team hands down.

author: APE FortyFour
text: Stalwarts of the Onsite Sewage System Industry. If you want to get something done right, give the job to a busy person. There is a good reason they are busy. I have worked with these professionals for years on multiple sites. Highly recommended

author: Kathie Jurek
text: I can't say enough good things about Davis Septic Design. When we discovered our drainfield was root bound, my husband and I were extremely concerned because our property has a lot of constraints that made space for a new system limited. I was absolutely on the verge of a full mental breakdown when I called Jennifer. She was able to send the team out extremely fast and they were able to find a spot for a new system. As a homeowner, it really, really sucks to have a huge expense like a septic replacement, but you literally could not go with better folks for the design process.

author: Michael Roberts
text: Davis Septic designed our septic system and we are happy to report on the success of their work for us. The plan that Brad and Ramsey presented to us was based on adapting to our property and providing us with a plan that gives us a very efficient and reliable new septic system. Throughout the process of design, county approval, and selection of an installer firm, the communication with Brad and Jennifer as well as Ramsey was a big help. During the actual installation, whenever there were questions about the process, it was easy and reassuring to reach out to the Davis office. We were always treated with respect and understanding as the process of moving from plan to action progressed. With help from Davis, we could see that our installer was able to communicate about the design and clarify the processes involved. It is clear to us now that this communication is based on years of experience and on the trust between design firm and the installer company. We appreciate Davis Septic and we recommend them.
